scope: Five current-only cooperative Rust-fixture observations; one first call plus 31 sequential warm calls per fresh service. No prior outbound implementation, task-success, model-token, cost, or client-adoption comparison. Native test driver records phase accounting and exact observed identities.

execution.artifact_environment: FORGE_TEST_OUTBOUND_REPORT is a distinct absolute create_new path for each run; other fixture environment and release commands are documented in docs/performance.md

initial_failures: First wire run refused group-writable test-owned inputs before endpoint launch. Second run failed a cleanup assertion that confused the supervisor subgroup with the owned service root. Fixtures were corrected without weakening production policy. Failed roots retained; no cleanup PASS claimed for those runs. Initial integrated Clippy needless-borrow failure was corrected.

observation.scope: current-only fixed 1 first + 31 sequential warm roundtrips, zero retries; transport includes send/receive framing and JSON conversion, oracle separate; no before/after or task-benefit claim

timing_scope.tools_discovery: inbound harness catalog only; remote initialize and tools/list are included in first call
